tools.name: get_company
tools.description: What iMpact does: its three businesses (Reputation Management, iMpact Academy, Global Connect Show), the 5R methodology, pricing model, offices, languages, leadership and how to reach each team.

tools.name: search_case_studies
tools.description: Search iMpact's client case studies (PR launches, media coverage, crisis, GEO, corporate training) by client, industry, market or keyword. Each result has the client, year, summary, results, outlets and a link. Empty query returns the most recent.

tools.name: send_inquiry
tools.description: Send the user's request to the right iMpact team by email: reputation (PR, media coverage, launches, crisis, GEO), academy (training, study tours, advisory), gcs (Global Connect Show events) or media (journalists). Reply within 24 hours.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_case_studies · Public sink: send_inquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_case_studies · Public sink: send_inquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
